items.title: Browns get another fourth-quarter comeback, defeat Texans 27-24
items.text: Cleveland is now 4-0 at home for the first time since 1963.

items.title: Carson Beck on his first start: It was cool, but losing is awful

items.title: Dak Prescott: 49ers fans "were more present than ours"

items.title: Christian McCaffrey on career-high receiving yards: You just catch it and run as fast as you can

items.title: Colts to stick with Daniel Jones as their starter for Thursday night's game
items.text: The Colts ended a five-game losing streak against the Dolphins on Sunday, but it wasn't because of a strong game from quarterback Daniel Jones.

items.title: No word on severity of Brock Bowers's ankle injury, will be re-evaluated Monday

items.title: Christian McCaffrey, 49ers run past Cowboys 46-40
items.text: The 49ers had 584 yards, the third-most the Cowboys have allowed in their history.

items.title: Emotional Kirk Cousins: "It's been a tough three years. There's more to the story being written."

items.title: Colts lead Dolphins 14-7 at halftime
items.text: Laquon Treadwell caught a 7-yard touchdown pass from Daniel Jones with 39 seconds left in the first half, giving the Colts a 14-7 lead over the Dolphins at halftime.

items.title: Colts hold off Dolphins 24-22
items.text: The Dolphins had a chance for their second win this season, but two missed field goals by Zane Gonzalez and a failed 2-point conversion allowed the Colts to hold onto a 24-22 win.
